family: idealised two-compartment Ross-Macdonald with sinusoidal temperature forcing; EIP/latency deliberately omitted
state_note: Numerical stress test ONLY. It carries no epidemiological claim about Guangzhou 2025 and must never be used to infer one.

equations.N_v: m*N_h (constant; no seasonality and no mu_s scaling)

scenario_note: m = 1.0 is a SCENARIO SETTING. It is not a fitted quantity and not a literature value; it only sets the scale of R0. It must never be described otherwise (see the honesty block of the experiment config).

thermal_traits.source: Mordecai et al. 2017, PLoS NTD 11(4):e0005568, Table A (Ae. albopictus)
thermal_traits.note: Traits are reused because they are LITERATURE values, not project estimates. No other parameter flows from the M-WSPM card into this experiment.

T_daily.note: hashed as an input for provenance; the temperature actually used here is the synthetic T_mean + A*sin(...) profile defined in the experiment config, NOT this file

Lambda_daily.note: unused by this experiment; listed only so mwspm_run_finalize can hash the standard input set

observations_weekly.note: unused by this experiment; this model produces no observable fit and no R2 is computed

window.relative_time_note: t = 0 is an unnamed reference day, not bound to the 2025 calendar

provenance.source_project: none - this model is written from scratch for the numerical stress test

caveats: This card exists so that scripts/reproduce.m can hash and freeze it; it is deliberately minimal.
No claim in CLAIMS.csv may be supported by this model except CL-08, whose failure mode is registered as stop condition S2.
